body:
Add a deterministic regression for the post-dispatch presentation record failure boundary. When the native observation has completed and the original reply is persisted but the presentation record cannot be written, the exchange must retain request/reply evidence, consume the command ID, latch STOP, and refuse a later observation without replay.

Validation: the new test and existing primary exchange suite pass (12/12); `git diff --check` passes. This is separate from PR #8781 startup-error coverage.
